name: Stars and Labeled-Tree Extremality
hypotheses: Finite nonempty classes, with inactive coordinates suppressed.
statement: A class has labeled-tree equality $|H|=|\mathcal T_{\mathrm{sh}}(H)|$ exactly when it is ample with Littlestone dimension at most one; its one-inclusion graph is then a star.
proof: The sequential-relationships theorem identifies labeled-tree equality with ampleness and Littlestone dimension at most one. An ample class of VC dimension at most one has a tree as its one-inclusion graph. Such a tree has Littlestone dimension at most one exactly when it contains no four-vertex path, equivalently when it has diameter at most two and is a star.
